intent: Export a typed cyclic group object of order 24 on the carrier I_24_v1, so scope-extension work may reference an explicit Z_24 action instead of an untyped integer range.

notes.generator_nonuniqueness: A choice of generator is not canonical: Aut(Z_24) ≅ (Z/24Z)^× has 8 units {1,5,7,11,13,17,19,23}. This object does not fix an embedding Z_24 -> U(1) as canonical.

hard_limits: Does not export any canonical phase embedding nor any Berry/holonomy primitive.
Does not cut the QW-2191 O(2) family and does not export any theta supply on n=24.
Does not claim any physical identification with the strict n=12 scaffolds.
